trials.name: coarse_grained
trials.purpose: Keep Conservative UMAP fixed; require larger and denser HDBSCAN clusters to test broad themes, merging, and exclusion of rare subjects.

selection_policy: Coarse-grained selected by the research team for the active broad-theme analysis. This is a study decision, not proof of superiority or expert validation. Conservative results are retained unchanged as historical evidence.
interpretation: Fresh TF-IDF/SVD, fresh frozen Legal-BERT inference, and six new UMAP/HDBSCAN fits (two models, seeds 42/43/44). No previous vectors or clustering assignments reused. Legal-BERT is not fine-tuned. Unchanged audited corpus, preprocessing and temporal window.
